ms.report:
For Milestone1, we have succeeded to decide the location for the information center.
 
The place is here.
1-16-19 Ebisu, Shibuya-ku, Tokyo, Japan
東京都渋谷区恵比寿1-16-19 1F
7 min from Ebisu Station.
 
https://s.tabelog.com/tokyo/A1303/A130302/13287604/
(This link indicate the present restaurant at 2024 1st Aug.)
 
The main reason I chose this store was because it met the following conditions.
 
Within walking distance from major stations in Tokyo
Rent is less than 300,000 yen
It is a roadside store that is easy to enter.
 
On the other hand, we are aware that there is a problem with the limited number of seats.
The current store is a small store with 8 seats. However, considering the recent rent situation in Tokyo, if the store is expanded beyond the one selected this time, the increase in maintenance costs will become a serious issue.
Therefore, we are thinking of operating a cafe mainly for takeout during the day, and in the evening, 6 seats near the table will be open as usual, and 2 seats will be located a little further away. The store will also feature poster panels and booklets introducing the Cardano project. We will also support the use of Daedalus by providing rental PCs that can be synchronized within 3-4 days and high-performance PCs in-store that can be synchronized within a few hours.
Originally, it would be preferable to install an RTX4090, but considering that the RTX5090 is scheduled to be released early next year, we are planning to use a notebook PC equipped with an RTX4060 for the time being. Ryzen-based products are also being considered in light of recent Intel issues.
We have been considering other stores in the past. For example, we have been negotiating for a cafe called Kocha at Oimachi Station.
https://tabelog.com/tokyo/A1315/A131501/13242784/
